units: input/output: USD per 1M tokens on the paid tier; thinking tokens bill as output. per_image: approximate USD per 1K image. changes: scheduled price changes, applied automatically from their date.

gemini-4-carbon.use_for: Google's strongest reasoning model, built for complex software engineering. Hardest reviews and design questions. Slowest. Needs a billing-enabled key.

gemini-4-neon.use_for: Frontier-level and fast. Strong all-round second opinion; needs a billing-enabled key.

gemini-4-argon.use_for: Efficient frontier reasoning: fewer tokens and faster than Carbon for complex coding. Needs a billing-enabled key.

gemini-4-hydrogen.use_for: Everyday coding and agentic questions at half Neon's price. The built-in default: works with free-tier keys.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.use_for: Fastest and cheapest: trivial or high-volume tasks.

gemini-nano-banana-2.1.use_for: Default image model: general images and edits.

gemini-3-pro-image.use_for: Text-heavy or professional images; about 4x the default's price.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image.use_for: Cheapest images; weaker with several reference images.
